description: How much of an ERC-20 token a wallet holds on Base, returned both human-formatted (using the token's decimals) and raw. Pass the token contract address and the holder address, both 0x + 40 hex. Example: USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913.

address.description: Wallet address whose balance to read: 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address on Base: 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

name: token_balance
title: Token Balance
